Title: Solution Architecture: Cyrena Coding Extensions
Content:
## Solution Architecture: Cyrena Coding Extensions (7 Projects)

This solution contains 7 Blazor Component Library / Class Library projects that extend the Cyrena AI assistant platform for software development.

### Project Structure

| Project | Type | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| **Cyrena.Coding.Core** | Class Library | Core contracts, models, and extensions for AI-assisted coding |
| **Cyrena.Coding.Extension** | Blazor Component Library | Developer assistant mode, file actions, version control, project info |
| **Cyrena.APIReferences** | Blazor Component Library | CRUD for API Reference documents (authoritative technical docs) |
| **Cyrena.Dotnet** | Blazor Component Library | .NET solution/project development (Class Lib, Blazor, MVC) |
| **Cyrena.ArduinoIDE** | Blazor Component Library | Arduino IDE sketch development |
| **Cyrena.PlatformIO** | Blazor Component Library | PlatformIO firmware development |
| **Cyrena.Angular** | Blazor Component Library | Angular application development (standalone components, signals, TypeScript) |

### Extension Dependency Chain

```
cyrena (core platform)
  └── cyrena.developer (v0.4.0) — Coding.Core + Coding.Extension
        ├── cyrena.api_references (v0.4.0) — APIReferences
        ├── cyrena.dotnet (v0.4.0) — Dotnet
        ├── cyrena.arduino_ide (v0.4.0) — ArduinoIDE
        ├── cyrena.platformio (v0.4.0) — PlatformIO
        └── cyrena.angular (v0.4.0) — Angular
```

### Core Architecture Patterns

1. **Extension Pattern**: All extensions inherit `Cyrena.Extensa.Models.Extension`, override `BuildExtension(CyrenaBuilder)`
2. **ICodeBuilder Pattern**: Each project type implements `ICodeBuilder` to configure `DevelopPlan`, register plugins, and set up prompts
3. **DevelopPlan**: In-memory file/folder index of the project directory. Files get `Id` prefixes based on folder (e.g., `contracts_`, `models_`, `services_`)
4. **Semantic Kernel Plugins**: AI tools exposed via `[KernelFunction]` attributes (FileActions, ProjectInformation, APIReferences, etc.)
5. **IStore<T>**: Generic persistence via `Cyrena.Persistence.Core` (singleton per entity type)
6. **Shortcuts**: `IShortcut` implementations for creating new conversations (dialog → config → kernel)
7. **Version Control**: In-memory capped history (`IVersionControl`) for AI-modified files

### Key Contracts (Cyrena.Coding.Core)

- `ICodeBuilder` — Project type configuration
- `IDevelopPlanService` — Access/modify current DevelopPlan
- `IVersionControl` — Capped file version history (max 20 default)

### Key Models (Cyrena.Coding.Core)

- `DevelopPlan` — Root directory, files, folders, data directory
- `DevelopFile` / `DevelopFileContent` / `DevelopFileLines` — File representations
- `DevelopFolder` — Recursive folder structure
- `DevelopFileVersion` — Timestamped snapshot with optional label
- `StickyNote` — AI-persisted project notes

### DevelopOptions Constants

- `AssistantModeId = "developer"`
- `BuilderId = "dev.builder-id"`
- `RootDirectory = "dev.root-dir"`

### File ID Prefix Conventions

| Folder | Prefix | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Attributes | `attributes_` | `attributes_MyAttribute` |
| Contracts | `contracts_` | `contracts_IUserService` |
| Extensions | `extensions_` | `extensions_MyExtensions` |
| Models | `models_` | `models_UserModel` |
| Options | `options_` | `options_MyOptions` |
| Services | `services_` | `services_UserService` |
| Components (root) | `blazor_root_` | `blazor_root_MyApp` |
| Components/Pages | `blazor_pages_` | `blazor_pages_Index` |
| Components/Layout | `blazor_layout_` | `blazor_layout_MainLayout` |
| Components/Shared | `blazor_shared_` | `blazor_shared_MyForm` |
| wwwroot/css | `public_stylesheet_` | `public_stylesheet_styles` |
| wwwroot/js | `public_script_` | `public_script_scripts` |
| Controllers | `controllers_` | `controllers_HomeController` |
| Views | `views_` | `views_Index` |
| .csproj | `csproj_` | `csproj_MyProject` |
| TypeScript | `ts_` | `ts_user-profile.component` |
| HTML | `html_` | `html_user-profile.component` |
| CSS | `css_` | `css_user-profile.component` |
| SCSS | `scss_` | `scss_variables` |
| LESS | `less_` | `less_theme` |
| JSON | `json_` | `json_angular` |

### Public Surfaces Requiring API References

All public types in Contracts, Models, Options, Extensions, Services (if public), and Blazor components must have API Reference docs.
